summary: Compared the catalogues page-banner reference, rendered crop, diff, and image diagnostics. The correct orchard composition and rounded geometry are present, but text styling and image/overlay rendering differ.
issues: VIS-PAGE-BANNER-CATALOGUES-001 (medium) — property: breadcrumb colors/metrics; expected: muted-gray parent and separator with green active 'Katalogi'; actual: the parent is black and the whole breadcrumb uses different weight/spacing; fix: apply the source breadcrumb color roles and typography.

VIS-PAGE-BANNER-CATALOGUES-002 (medium) — property: banner image/overlay appearance; expected: retained orchard source with the reference green overlay/luminance; actual: the same composition is visible but image-interior diagnostics report 33,288 differing pixels and the diff highlights foliage across the banner; fix: keep the source asset/crop and match the reference overlay color, opacity, and image rendering.

VIS-PAGE-BANNER-CATALOGUES-003 (low) — property: heading typography/alignment; expected: source title metrics centered at the retained location; actual: title is slightly larger/differently weighted and shifted left; fix: match the source heading font metrics and center it within the banner.
